summary: Implement the student-facing practice exam execution UI using React, TypeScript, and Vite. Includes question rendering (multiple-choice and open-ended/short answer), navigation, local response state persistence via localStorage, incremental background sync, advisory disclaimer, session finalization, mock API layer, and Vitest test suite.

changed_files.purpose: Append frontend build output and dependency folders to repository gitignore.
Define project dependencies, scripts (including Vitest non-watch execution), and metadata.
TypeScript compiler configuration for React, JSX, and module resolution.
Vite and Vitest test environment configuration.
Entry HTML document for the single-page application.
Test setup file importing jest-dom matchers and cleaning mock storage.
TypeScript interface definitions matching the approved API schemas for exam sessions.
Mock API service matching the approved exam execution endpoints.
Main exam interface component managing questions, answer tracking, localStorage caching, navigation, and submission.
Mounts React application to the DOM.
Unit and integration tests verifying exam question rendering, localStorage state retention, navigation, advisory disclaimer, and final submission.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: UI renders generated practice exams with appropriate inputs for multiple-choice and open-ended questions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PracticeExamView.tsx renders multiple-choice options with radio inputs and short answer questions with a textarea input, verified by PracticeExamView.test.tsx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Student response states are tracked and preserved during an active exam session.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: handleAnswerChange updates component state and syncs to browser localStorage under exam_answers_{examId}, preserving answers across page reloads. Tested in PracticeExamView.test.tsx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Submission endpoint captures student answers and finalizes the exam session.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The real backend submission endpoint is not implemented yet. The UI submits to a frontend mock API service simulating POST /api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/submit.

assumptions: The initial view can mount with exam_77d8e9f as default until route parameters or exam selection flows are introduced.
unresolved_issues: Actual integration with live backend endpoints will be addressed when T6/T8 backend services are deployed.
